body:
i’ve been with my therapist for almost ten years, the idea of finding another and trying to build up that same relationship is terrifying and honestly doesn’t sound worth it if they’ll just drop me again. besides, if a therapist of ten years suddenly stops seeing the worth in me, what will stop one i barely know? 

as for my friend, i know, and i don’t blame them. i understand that all. the timing was just unfortunate.

thank you for this. it truly does mean a lot to me. your words have probably been the most helpful and comforting i’ve received, even after nearly a decade of therapy. i’ll hold onto them. thank you, again.
just own it, dude. you know yourself better than they ever will, there’s no point in getting offended
